definition: the missing memory and the missing picture that leave food nearly flat

settled:
I cannot call back what a meal was like, so there is nothing to reminisce over. I cannot picture one ahead either, so there is nothing to look forward to.

What is left is the enjoyment in the moment, and that only arrives when I am doing well, and even then it is muted.

So the food-as-pleasure engine that drives most overeating is barely running in me. A plain, repetitive, functional diet is not something I am enduring.

title: Why A Meal Does So Little For Me
